question: Across the deterministic holdout fields, what relation yield follows from proved rank-one models and how early is the directly testable public relation?
selection: base curve on each field plus every nonbase rank-one cell whose exact rank, trivial torsion, and signed generator are all proved by the frozen screen and generator audit
target: Q=17G fixture on each prime-order field
admission: both public points nonidentity and distinct, then both lie in one model's radius-four generator image
direct_control: on the same ordered query law, test R1+2R2=O for every nonidentity distinct pair and stop at first hit
stopping_rule: retain complete per-model statuses and all positive rational relation rows; report earliest direct and rational events separately
cost_boundary: count every public query, per-model membership check, admitted rational group test, and direct public group test; retain all 40 rank attempts and three generator proofs as setup
claim_boundary: exact finite-panel event and operation counts; no wall-time or same-target rho comparison
